与城市生活一起成长(Growing up with city life): 一篇关于城市生活的B1记叙文:杰克的经历、感受与成长。

Eva and Jack are preparing a report about the bus terminal. The subway station has become an important part of daily life. People around Jack often share different ideas about the bus terminal. Best of all, our neighbourhood has a small park.

Jack will take part in a table tennis match in October. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Jack plans to study music harder this term. Her personal trainer helps her exercise three times a week.

Eva always says that small steps matter more than big plans. There are always more possibilities than we expect. At first, Jack found it difficult to keep the habit. In fact, the clearance sale emptied the shelves.

The experience taught Jack more than any book could. The bus terminal looked quieter than usual that evening. Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The philosophy lecture opened with Descartes.
Jack thanked Eva for the honest advice. On Tuesday evenings, Jack reviews the notes from class. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on.
